name: 东南大学
character: A green, open, symmetrically laid-out campus blending Chinese and Western styles, featuring six-story white-walled buildings with pitched roofs, concentric ring roads, and a lake.

landmarks.name: 李文正图书馆
landmarks.quote: 两条轴线交汇于校园中心的李文正图书馆。
landmarks.look: Five-story neoclassical library on raised base with gray-white granite facade and wide colonnade.

landmarks.name: 九龙湖
landmarks.quote: 九龙湖水被从校园西北角引入校区，并在校园内形成主要的景观空间。
landmarks.look: Lake entering from the northwest corner, forming the main water landscape.

landmarks.name: 九曲桥
landmarks.quote: 但在西北角被九龙湖截断，并以九曲桥连接
landmarks.look: Zigzag bridge spanning the lake along the innermost circular campus road.

landmarks.name: 大学生活动中心-焦廷标馆
landmarks.name_en: Student Activity Center - Jiao Tingbiao Hall
landmarks.quote: 大学生活动中心-焦廷标馆综合体由史晓川设计
landmarks.look: Asymmetric complex with six-story block, round hall, cabin-shaped auditorium, and red walls.

landmarks.name: 体育馆
landmarks.quote: 九龙湖校区体育馆位于校园东门，为东西轴线最重要的门户景观。
landmarks.look: Circular bowl-shaped stadium with vertical lines and four indoor training halls.

landmarks.name: 东门
landmarks.quote: 九龙湖校区体育馆位于校园东门
landmarks.look: Campus east gate along the east-west axis.
